verdict.line: You lose if you trade face-to-face into a fresh Ki Burst (W) or let the fight drag long enough for Riven's Conqueror stacks to ramp; you win by forcing fights when her W and Q are both down, which is exactly what the 51.9% win rate over 742 games rewards.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's kit is built for sustained pressure — Umbral Dash (E) heals on every point of champion damage and The Darkin Blade (Q) resets down to a 6s cooldown at max rank — while Riven's kit is burst-then-reposition: a stun, three dash charges, and a damage-blocking step, all on short cooldowns. The matchup is decided by whether you engage into her cooldowns or into her kit, which is why Aatrox holds both the lane-advantage and solo-kill-advantage split in the data.

theirWindow.when: Her W and Q are both up
theirWindow.what: She can stun with Ki Burst then dump all three Broken Wings charges plus Runic Blade-empowered autos. Hold your Umbral Dash (E) to reposition out rather than standing to trade.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Ki Burst) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and commit. Without the stun she only has Valor (E, range 250) to block a slice of your damage once, and you land Q swings and Infernal Chains (W) freely.

start.why: Sustains you through early trades so you can contest her Q pokes without conceding health, matching the aggressive shape of this matchup.

boots.why: Cuts down the empowered autos she gets from Runic Blade charges, which is where a lot of her sustained lane damage comes from.

core.why: The proc shield and burst reward you for initiating trades on your terms, backing the data's solo-kill advantage.
Bonus healing on crit against a low-HP-pool laner keeps you ahead in extended skirmishes.
Damage-over-time sustain outlasts her burst windows once she's stacked Conqueror in a long fight.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained-trade, all-in approach this matchup calls for and scales the healing you already get from Umbral Dash.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate and pick rate (53.1%, 64.6% pick) for this matchup — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills instead of just wins on points.

playing.title: Walk up when both her cooldowns are down
playing.detail: Track Ki Burst (W, 11-7s) and Broken Wings (Q, 13s). When neither is up she has no stun and no reposition tool, so this is your safest window to force a trade.

playing.title: Dash through her Q3 knockback
playing.detail: Her third Broken Wings reactivation knocks back nearby enemies. Use Umbral Dash (E) to reposition through the knockback rather than getting shoved out — your dash still heals you on any damage dealt.

playing.title: Bait Valor before your real combo
playing.detail: Riven's Valor (E) blocks incoming damage over a short step and is only up every 10-6s. Throw a single Q swing first to bait it on cooldown before committing your full combo.

playing.title: Land Infernal Chains before she can shove off
playing.detail: W (Infernal Chains, 20-12s cooldown, 825 range) drags her back to center if she doesn't clear the impact area fast — land it early in the fight to deny her the exit her Q3 knockback would otherwise buy her.

playing.title: Force fights around her ultimate's long cooldown
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile starts at 120s and only gets short again after repeated ranks — most of laning phase it's a long-cooldown cooldown for her. Time your own World Ender (R) all-ins for windows when hers is clearly down.

playing.title: Don't grind long fights once she's stacked Conqueror
playing.detail: Her sustained damage ramps the longer a fight goes. Front-load your damage early in the exchange instead of trading passively into a stacked keystone.

playing.title: Time engages around Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Your passive periodically empowers your next auto with bonus magic damage and healing based on her max health. Hold your engage a beat if needed so the proc lands during the trade, not after she's already disengaged.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability interactions, cooldown timing, and tactical reasoning are my own read of the matchup.
